children: Brazil's 2026 soybean exports are expected to total 115 million metric tons, crushers group Abiove said on Friday, lowering its forecast by 400,000 tons after China - the world's largest importer - stepped up purchases of US soybeans.
The move marked Abiove's first cut to its monthly estimates since at least March.
Even so, Brazil's 2026 soybean exports are still estimated to rise 6.3% from the previous year.
Brazil, the world's largest soybean producer and exporter, harvested a record crop of more than 180 million tons in the first half of the year.
